# Load data

```{r}
ps_rare_16S <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))
ps_rare_ITS <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))

# Make data fit for plot
B = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rare_16S) 
# Possible to focus on a reduced dataset ex. B = subset_taxa(S_ps_rare_16S, Genus == "Chlamydiae")

B$LifeStage <- factor(B$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
B$FruitType <- factor(B$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

# write.table(x=B, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "16S_melt.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")


L = phyloseq::psmelt(ps_rare_ITS)

L$LifeStage <- factor(L$LifeStage, levels = c("Mother", "Larva", "Pupa", "PupalCase","Daughter", "na"))
L$FruitType <- factor(L$FruitType, levels = c("BL", "CH", "ST", "na"))

# write.table(x=L, file=file.path(here::here(),"data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "ITS_melt.csv"), row.names=FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=";")
```

``` {r}
# Distinguish "Unknown" families by numeroting them with their corresponding cluster number

tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S)) # Extract taxonomy table as a data frame
otu_names <- rownames(tax) # Extract OTU names

tax$Family <- ifelse(
  tax$Family == "Unknown",
  paste0("Unknown_", sub("Cluster_", "", otu_names)), # Add suffix with cluster number if Family == "Unknown"
  as.character(tax$Family))

tax_table(ps_rare_16S) <- as.matrix(tax) # Put it back into the phyloseq object
write.table(tax_table(ps_rare_16S), file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "16S_TM1&2_tax_table_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)


tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS)) # Extract taxonomy table as a data frame
otu_names <- rownames(tax) # Extract OTU names

tax$Family <- ifelse(
  tax$Family == "Unknown",
  paste0("Unknown_", sub("Cluster_", "", otu_names)), # Add suffix with cluster number if Family == "Unknown"
  as.character(tax$Family))

tax_table(ps_rare_ITS) <- as.matrix(tax) # Put it back into the phyloseq object
write.table(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS), file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "ITS_TM1&2_tax_table_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)
```

# I. Composition (abundance)

## 1. Bar plots

### a. Fruits 
```{r}
# subset data
ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))

ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))
```

#### SampleType + FruitType
```{r}
# 16S (Family)
plot_16S_SampleTypeFruitType <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly, "Bacteria", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType, color_16S)

plot_16S_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_16S_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days")) # reorder sample type 

ggsave(filename = "B_Abundance_Sample_Type_Fruit_Type.jpg", plot = plot_16S_SampleTypeFruitType, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# ITS (Family)
plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly, "Fungi", "Family", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType, color_ITS)

plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days")) # reorder sample type 

ggsave(filename = "Y_Abundance_Sample_Type_Fruit_Type.jpg", plot = plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")


# ITS (Genus)
plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType_GENUS <- Make_composition_bar_plot_2(ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly, "Fungi", "Genus", 15, ~SampleType + FruitType, color_ITS_genus)

plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType_GENUS$data$SampleType <- factor(plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType$data$SampleType, levels = c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days")) # reorder sample type 

ggsave(filename = "Y_Abundance_Sample_Type_Fruit_Type_GENUS.jpg", plot = plot_ITS_SampleTypeFruitType_GENUS, path = file.path(here::here(), "plots", "3_CommunityComposition"), width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")
```

### b. Individuals
```{r}
# subset phyloseq object 
ps_rare_16S_Indiv <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, LifeStage !="na" & Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

ps_rare_ITS_Indiv <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage !="na" & Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")
```

### c. Indiv + Aunts + Host Fruits
```{r}
# Filter data
ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

ps_16S_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_rare_expe, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Aunts = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

desired_order <- c("Fruits_0days", "Aunts", "Mothers", "Larvae", "Fruits_5_6days", "Pupae", "PupalCases", "Daughters")  
sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_16S_rare_expe)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)


ps_ITS_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, Sample_Category == "All_stages_Focal_Sites")

ps_ITS_rare_expe <- Subset_physeq(ps_ITS_rare_expe, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))

# rename + reorder Sample Type
sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType)

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType %>%
  forcats::fct_recode(
    Aunts = "G0_Adults_0days",
    Mothers = "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days",
    Larvae = "G1_Larvae_Fruits",
    Fruits_5_6days = "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days",
    Pupae = "G1_Pupae_Fruits",
    PupalCases = "G1_PupalCase_Fruits",
    Daughters = "G1_Adults_Fruits")

sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType <- factor(sample_data(ps_ITS_rare_expe)$SampleType, levels = desired_order)
```

## 2. Reduced physeq object based on shared ASVs
### All fruits
```{r}
# Combine ASVs lists
sharedASVs_B <- unique(c(L_sharedASVs_B, M_sharedASVs_B, f_sharedASVs_B, A_sharedASVs_B))
sharedASVs_Y <- unique(c(L_sharedASVs_Y, M_sharedASVs_Y, f_sharedASVs_Y, A_sharedASVs_Y))

ps_16S_rare_expe_red <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_rare_expe, SampleType %in% c("Aunts", "Fruits_0days", "Larvae", "Mothers"))
ps_ITS_rare_expe_red <- Subset_physeq(ps_ITS_rare_expe, SampleType %in% c("Aunts", "Fruits_0days", "Larvae", "Mothers"))


# Reduced taxa and samples of physeq object
ps_rare_16S_expe_reduced <- prune_samples(
  sample_names(ps_16S_rare_expe_red)[
    rowSums(otu_table(prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_16S_rare_expe_red) %in% sharedASVs_B, ps_16S_rare_expe_red)) > 0) > 0],
  prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_16S_rare_expe_red) %in% sharedASVs_B, ps_16S_rare_expe_red))

ps_rare_ITS_expe_reduced <- prune_samples(
  sample_names(ps_ITS_rare_expe_red)[
    rowSums(otu_table(prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_ITS_rare_expe_red) %in% sharedASVs_Y, ps_ITS_rare_expe_red)) > 0) > 0],
  prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_ITS_rare_expe_red) %in% sharedASVs_Y, ps_ITS_rare_expe_red))
```

## 3. Plot Venn diagram on samples 
### All fruits
```{r}
### 16S ###
taxa_by_type <- list(Aunts = A_sharedASVs_B, Fruits_0days= f_sharedASVs_B,  Mothers = M_sharedASVs_B, Larvae  = L_sharedASVs_B)

sample_types <- unique(sample_data(ps_rare_16S_expe_reduced)$SampleType)

color_LifeStage <- c("Aunts"  = "goldenrod2", "Fruits_0days"  = "darkolivegreen4","Mothers" = "darkorange2","Larvae"  = "darkolivegreen2")

SC_16S_SampleType <- ggVennDiagram(taxa_by_type, label = "count",label_alpha = 0,edge_size = 1,set_color = color_LifeStage) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "grey") +
  labs(title = "16S", fill = "Taxa number") +
  theme_void()

ggsave(here::here("plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "SharedCore_16S_SampleType.png"),
  SC_16S_SampleType,  width = 16, height = 12, units = "cm", dpi = 1200)


### ITS ###
taxa_by_type_Y <- list(Aunts = A_sharedASVs_Y, Fruits_0days= f_sharedASVs_Y,  Mothers = M_sharedASVs_Y, Larvae  = L_sharedASVs_Y)

SC_ITS_SampleType <- ggVennDiagram(taxa_by_type_Y, label = "count",label_alpha = 0,edge_size = 1,set_color = color_LifeStage) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "grey") +
  labs(title = "ITS", fill = "Taxa number") +
  theme_void()

ggsave(here::here("plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "SharedCore_ITS_SampleType.png"),
  SC_ITS_SampleType,  width = 16, height = 12, units = "cm", dpi = 1200)

### COMBINED ###
SC_combined <- (SC_16S_SampleType / SC_ITS_SampleType) + plot_layout(ncol = 1) & theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave(here::here("plots", "3_CommunityComposition", "SharedCore_16S&ITS_SampleType.png"),
  SC_combined,  width = 20, height = 30, units = "cm", dpi = 1200)
```
